samples.summary: Frontend now treats `canManage` as required and hard-gates the Details link on it; any producer that does not send the field (older backend during a rolling deploy, cached response, or any future caller of `getWorkspaceAnalytics`) makes every row's link disappear with no fallback
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/workspaces/workspace-analytics.tsx:92 renders the link only when `r.canManage` is truthy; `packages/frontend/src/api/workspaces.ts:244` declares it required, but the value arrives from JSON and is only populated by the new backend path at packages/backend/src/analytics/analytics.controller.ts:245. `undefined` degrades to 'no one can drill in' silently. Note the warehouse itself defaults every row to `canManage: false` (packages/backend/src/analytics/analytics-warehouse.service.ts:240), so any future consumer of `getWorkspaceAnalytics` that skips the controller enrichment inherits the same all-hidden behaviour.

samples.summary: The sibling consumer of the same manager gate — the workspace roll-up page — still shows the generic 'Failed to load analytics.' on any error, so the new HttpError-403 handling is applied inconsistently across the two pages that call the analytics API
